summary: Iteration 11 retest of the church site fixes. Backend: 9 of 9 pytest tests pass. Admin unblock with blocked:false now returns 200 and the user can log in afterwards; blocking an admin still returns 400. All 137 git-tracked repo files exist in /app/church, and the src/pages file list is identical to /tmp/igrejanovo. The only content differences are the hash-prefixed hrefs. HashRouter works: the main iframe menu links render real content for INÍCIO, ESTUDO, CULTOS AO VIVO, MISSÕES, MINISTÉRIOS, INFANTIL, PAINEL INFANTIL (placeholder dashboard) and CANTINA. A reload inside the iframe works. Opening /igreja/#/estudo and /igreja/#/ministerios directly and reloading works. Every route in App.tsx renders without a 404, including /ministerios/<slug> (7 slugs), /ministerio-dos-jovens, /kids, /login, /forgot-password, /setup-admin, /reset-password, /auth/callback, /dashboard/*, /kids/dashboard/*, and /dashboard/kids/*. church-back-btn goes to / when logged out and to /home when logged in, even after iframe navigation. Mobile 390px bottom nav: all labels are single-line with no clipping, for both the 8-item migrant nav and the 9-item admin nav. New regression caused by HashRouter: the 'CÉLULAS' and 'FAMÍLIA PASTORAL' menu items, and every in-page anchor button, show the church 404 page.

ui_bugs.component: Church menu CÉLULAS / FAMÍLIA PASTORAL (ElementorHeader.tsx nav, lines 28-29)
ui_bugs.issue: href='#celulas' and href='#pastoral' are read by HashRouter as routes 'celulas' and 'pastoral', so the iframe shows '404 Oops! Page not found'. Two of the 11 menu items are broken.

These all lead to the 404 page under HashRouter (3 verified, the rest share the same pattern): Cantina 'Horários' (#horarios), Estudo 'Ver agenda' (#agenda), Missões 'Como participar' (#participar), CultosAoVivo '#catalogo', MinisterioJovens 'Atividades' (#atividades), KidsPlatform 'Ver turmas' (#turmas).

issues: The 'PEDIDOS DE ORAÇÃO' link goes to the external missionevangeliquelusitana.com site with no target=_blank, so it navigates inside the iframe. This is the same as in the original repo, and the domain did not resolve from the test container. Consider target='_blank'.
The 'Abrir em nova aba' button always opens /igreja/ (the home page) rather than the current church page. Minor.

action_items: Fix the anchor links under HashRouter. Change the CÉLULAS and FAMÍLIA PASTORAL nav items to router paths that scroll on the home page (e.g. to='/?s=celulas' or state). Index.tsx then calls document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView() in a useEffect. Or use an onClick handler that runs navigate('/') and then scrollIntoView.

Replace the in-page HeroGhostButton/anchor hrefs ('#horarios', '#agenda', '#participar', '#catalogo', '#atividades', '#turmas') with an onClick scrollIntoView, e.g. a shared ScrollLink component. Then rebuild /app/church into /app/frontend/public/igreja.
Optional: add target='_blank' rel='noreferrer' to the external links in the church nav and Index (Pedidos de Oração, células nas casas).
critical_code_review_comments: ElementorHeader treats any href not starting with '/' as a plain <a>. Under HashRouter, plain '#x' anchors conflict with routing, so a generic hash-anchor helper is needed.
The /dashboard and /kids/dashboard ProtectedRoute pages render the placeholder UI without auth. This matches the upstream repo (the placeholder is intentional) and is noted only for awareness.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all routes and the main menu work; 2 of 11 menu items and 6 anchor buttons give a 404)

In the church iframe, get the frame via element_handle().content_frame() (page.frames[1] is about:blank). After the fix, verify that clicking the CÉLULAS/FAMÍLIA PASTORAL nav items and the hero anchor buttons scrolls to the section without a 404 (check that document.body.innerText does not contain 'Oops! Page not found').
rca of the issue: HashRouter uses location.hash as the route. An <a href='#celulas'> sets the hash to '#celulas', which HashRouter parses as pathname 'celulas'. That matches no route, so path='*' renders NotFound. Repro: open /igreja/#/cantina and click 'Horários'. The URL becomes /igreja/#horarios and the page shows 404.
